correctness.rationale: Kummer carries establish exact binary support; the closest previous admissible endpoint is obtained by an exact lexicographically greedy binary suffix. Four-step suffix recurrences solve to the asserted floor formulas for every j, with explicit witnesses realizing all lengths. Strict interlacing yields genuine first-occurrence records. Splitting bit positions by parity proves Fibonacci product. Standalone exact checks from the current package corroborate the results; no step relies on finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Fixed parameter (5,1) is the natural five-ary Fuss–Catalan sequence. This is an explicit complete infinite zero-run length spectrum, with endpoint realization and binary support census, motivated by the new Eu–Huang–Kao general Raney spectrum question. The known broad finite-family theorem does not supply these exact values, their attainability or the Fibonacci formula, so the contribution is a concrete structural instance rather than a restatement of general containment.
